title.zh: 【Symbiosis：已发现有人试图通过该协议转移币安被盗资金】
title.en: 【Symbiosis：已发现有人试图通过该协议转移币安被盗资金】

current_state.zh: Cross-chain protocol Symbiosis reported detecting attempts to move Binance attack-related stolen funds through its platform, saying it is working to block the transfers, has contacted Binance, and will tighten screening mechanisms that were designed for normal fund flows and proved weak against fast, complex operations.
